// RED fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the AGENT-FABRIC slice (AG-P3 / P-132).
// The lint MUST reject this. The Agent-Fabric hitl_gate / trace rows carry the per-run
// conversation/humanised card body the brain authored from tenant content (architecture
// agent-fabric §4.4 / §4.5). Here that free-text body field (`message_body`, a PII fingerprint —
// the analogue of the real `risk_summary` / `trace_body` Content fields) carries NO
// #[personal_data(...)] tag, so the per-subject DEK crypto-shred erase (contract 11.4) and the
// RoPA/data-map fan-out (AG-D10) would NOT reach it, leaving an un-erasable subject (ADR-12). The
// actor pseudonym (`agent_principal`) IS tagged here, isolating the failure to the deliberately
// untagged body field.
pub struct HitlGateRow {
    pub tenant: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
    pub gate_id: u128,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Identifier,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = UntilContractEnd,
        erasure = Pseudonymise,
        subject_locator = "agent_principal",
    )]
    pub agent_principal: String,
    pub message_body: Vec<u8>,
}
